title: Plurilock Shareholders Approve Plan of Arrangement for Acquisition by Quantum eMotion - Quantum Computing Report
gist: Plurilock Security shareholders approved its acquisition by Quantum eMotion with 99.58% of votes cast, at C$0.084 cash plus 0.0763 QNC shares per share (implied C$0.28); closing awaits a B.C. Supreme Court final order and customary conditions, followed by TSXV delisting.

insights.claim: Plurilock Security (TSXV: PLUR; OTCQB: PLCKF) shareholders approved the plan of arrangement for its acquisition by Quantum eMotion (NYSE American: QNC) with 99.58% of votes cast, and 99.54% excluding interested parties under MI 61-101, at a meeting representing 60.38% of outstanding shares.
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
insights.so_what: Shareholder risk to the deal is removed; remaining risk is court approval and closing conditions.
insights.locator: At a special meeting representing 68,226,137 shares

insights.claim: Under the September 28, 2026 arrangement agreement, Quantum eMotion will pay C$0.084 in cash plus 0.0763 of a Quantum eMotion share per Plurilock share, implying total consideration of C$0.28 per share.
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
insights.so_what: Mostly stock consideration means Plurilock holders' realized value tracks QNC's share price; a merger-arb spread depends on QNC.

insights.claim: Plurilock is seeking a final order from the Supreme Court of British Columbia, with closing and delisting from the TSX Venture Exchange expected after customary closing conditions are satisfied.
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
insights.so_what: Court order is the next catalyst for deal close.
